name: Guesty
pitch_then: Software that helps Airbnb hosts manage many rental listings, guest messages and cleaning schedules from one dashboard.
became: Grew into a short-term rental platform; valued at $1.3B in 2021 round.

name: Weave
pitch_then: Phone and messaging system that lets small businesses like dental offices see caller details and text patients.
became: Went public on NYSE in 2021; taken private by Francisco Partners for $650M in 2026.

name: Algolia
pitch_then: Offline search engine toolkit for mobile apps, letting users search local data instantly without a server.
became: Became a hosted search API used by thousands of sites; valued at $2.25B in 2021.

name: Checkr
pitch_then: Developer API that runs background checks on job applicants, built for on-demand gig companies.
became: Became the background-check standard for gig and hourly hiring; valued at $4.6B in 2022.

name: Clear
pitch_then: Website that helps salaried Indians file their income tax returns online in minutes.
became: Expanded into invoicing, GST, wealth and credit software for Indian businesses.

name: Permutive
pitch_then: Ad targeting platform that processes audience data on the reader's own device instead of tracking them with cookies.
became: Became a privacy-first publisher ad data platform; no reported valuation.

name: Rigetti Computing
pitch_then: Builds quantum computers from superconducting chips in its own fab and rents access to them over the cloud.
became: Went public via SPAC at about $1.5B in March 2022.

name: ShipBob
pitch_then: Warehouse and shipping network giving small online stores fast, cheap two-day delivery like the big retailers.
became: Grew into a global e-commerce fulfillment network; valued at $1.1B in 2021.

name: Front
pitch_then: Shared team inbox that lets coworkers assign, comment on and answer customer email together.
became: Became a customer communications hub; valued at $1.7B in 2022.

name: Cognito
pitch_then: API that lets online businesses verify a customer's identity by checking their details against records.
became: Bought by Plaid in January 2022, reportedly for about $250M.

name: Ginkgo Bioworks
pitch_then: Foundry that designs custom microbes for customers, using automation to engineer organisms instead of one-off lab work.
became: Went public via SPAC at about $15B in September 2021.

name: Helion Energy
pitch_then: Builds a fusion reactor that squeezes plasma with pulsed magnets to generate cheap electricity directly.
became: Raised $465M at a $15.5B valuation in 2026; building Microsoft's fusion plant.

name: Notable Labs
pitch_then: Tests a blood cancer patient's own cells against many drugs in a lab to pick the treatment most likely to work.
became: Reverse-merged into a listed biotech in 2023, then filed for bankruptcy.

name: Qventus
pitch_then: Software that predicts emergency room crowding and delays so hospitals can staff and schedule ahead.
became: Became a hospital operations AI platform; valued around $400M in 2025.

name: Akido Labs
pitch_then: Tech-enabled healthcare service aimed at bringing affordable care to underserved patients.
became: Pivoted to AI-assisted clinics; raised $60M Series B in 2025, valuation undisclosed.

name: Mezmo
pitch_then: Cloud log management tool that lets developers search and tail all their server logs from one place.
became: Became an observability data platform; no reported valuation.

name: Magic
pitch_then: Text a number to get human assistants to do any errand, from booking dinner to buying gifts.
became: Pivoted to business-focused remote assistants; no reported valuation.

name: Zeitview
pitch_then: Marketplace connecting businesses with freelance drone pilots who shoot aerial photos and video on demand.
became: Became drone and AI inspection software for solar and infrastructure; no reported valuation.

name: GrubMarket
pitch_then: Online marketplace delivering fresh produce from local farms to offices and homes.
became: Became a large food distribution and supply chain software company; valued at $3.5B in 2021.

name: Tempo
pitch_then: Depth camera that watches weightlifters and gives real-time feedback on their form at the gym.
became: Became a connected home gym with live classes; no reported current valuation.

name: Cleanly
pitch_then: On-demand app that picks up laundry and dry cleaning and delivers it back clean.
became: Still operating as a laundry delivery service; no reported valuation.

name: Lucira Health
pitch_then: Disposable at-home test kit that detects infectious diseases and gives a result in minutes.
became: IPO in February 2021 on COVID tests; filed Chapter 11 in February 2023.

name: EquipmentShare
pitch_then: Peer-to-peer marketplace for renting out idle construction equipment and tools between contractors.
became: Became a construction rental and telematics giant; Nasdaq IPO in January 2026.

name: GitLab
pitch_then: Open-source, self-hosted tool for storing code and managing software projects, an alternative to GitHub.
became: Nasdaq IPO in October 2021, closing day one near $14.9B.

name: Razorpay
pitch_then: Payment gateway that lets Indian businesses accept online payments with a few lines of code.
became: Became India's leading payments and banking platform; valued at $7.5B in 2021.

name: Mashgin
pitch_then: Countertop self-checkout kiosk that uses cameras to recognize items without scanning barcodes.
became: Deployed in stadiums, cafeterias and stores; no reported valuation.

name: Teleport
pitch_then: Packages cloud software so vendors can deploy and run it inside customers' own data centers using Kubernetes.
became: Pivoted to secure infrastructure access; valued at $1.1B in 2022.

name: Ironclad
pitch_then: Workflow software that helps companies draft, negotiate and sign contracts without emailing Word documents around.
became: Became a leading contract management platform; valued at $3.2B in 2022.

name: OpenInvest
pitch_then: Robo-advisor that builds investment portfolios matching each person's social and environmental values.
became: Acquired by J.P. Morgan in 2021; price undisclosed.

name: Chaldal
pitch_then: Online grocery delivery for households in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
became: Still Bangladesh's biggest online grocer; no reported valuation.

name: Drip Capital
pitch_then: Fast working-capital loans for Indian exporters waiting weeks to get paid by overseas buyers.
became: Grew into a global trade finance platform; no reported valuation.

name: Circle Medical
pitch_then: Primary care doctor visits by video, with in-person visits when needed, booked from a phone.
became: Grew into a multi-city primary care clinic network; no reported valuation.

name: Fountain
pitch_then: Tool that onboards new software customers over phone and text, verifying users and walking them through setup.
became: Pivoted to hiring software for high-volume hourly work; no reported valuation.

name: Plate IQ
pitch_then: App where restaurants snap photos of supplier invoices and the software enters them into accounting automatically.
became: Became an accounts payable automation platform for restaurants; no reported valuation.

name: Scentbird
pitch_then: Monthly subscription that mails small vials of designer perfume and cologne to try.
became: Still a fragrance subscription business; no reported valuation.

name: Xendit
pitch_then: Payment API that lets Indonesian online businesses accept bank transfers and cards.
became: Became a Southeast Asian payments leader; hit $1B valuation in 2021.

name: Go1
pitch_then: Single marketplace that bundles online training courses from many providers for companies to buy.
became: Became a corporate learning content platform; valued at $2B in 2021.

name: Instawork
pitch_then: On-demand app that connects restaurants and event venues with hourly workers for single shifts.
became: Grew into a large hourly staffing marketplace; no reported valuation.

name: Human Interest
pitch_then: Low-cost, automated 401(k) retirement plans aimed at small businesses that cannot afford traditional providers.
became: Became a leading small-business 401(k) provider; valued at $1.3B in 2021.

name: Lattice
pitch_then: Software for managers to run performance reviews, goals and ongoing feedback for employees.
became: Became a people management suite; valued at $3B in 2022.

name: GetAccept
pitch_then: Digital sales tool for sending proposals and collecting e-signatures to close deals faster.
became: Grew into a digital sales room platform; no reported valuation.

name: Tovala
pitch_then: Countertop oven that scans a barcode on a meal-kit box and cooks the meal automatically.
became: Became a smart oven and meal subscription business; no reported valuation.

name: Focal Systems
pitch_then: Shelf cameras with deep learning that spot empty shelves and pricing errors in grocery stores.
became: Sells shelf-monitoring AI to grocers; no reported valuation.

name: Truebill
pitch_then: App that finds forgotten subscriptions in your bank account, cancels them and negotiates lower bills.
became: Bought by Rocket Companies for $1.275B in 2021.

name: Opentrons
pitch_then: Low-cost open-source pipetting robots so biology labs can automate repetitive liquid-handling work.
became: Became a lab automation company; valued around $1.8B in 2021.

name: Superside
pitch_then: On-demand design team subscription that delivers logos, graphics and slides from remote designers.
became: Became an AI-assisted creative service for enterprises; no reported valuation.

name: Function of Beauty
pitch_then: Custom-formulated shampoo and conditioner mixed to each customer's hair type and goals after an online quiz.
became: Expanded into skin and body care; no reported valuation.

name: Luciq (formerly Instabug)
pitch_then: Mobile bug reporting tool where testers shake their phone to send screenshots and logs to developers.
became: Rebranded as an AI observability platform for mobile apps; no reported valuation.

name: Podium
pitch_then: Website chat widget that lets local businesses text with customers and collect reviews.
became: Became a messaging and payments platform for local businesses; valued at $3B in 2021.

name: Salt Security
pitch_then: Security software that spots attackers by learning how a company's software interfaces normally behave.
became: Became an API security leader; valued at $1.4B in 2022.

name: Apollo.io
pitch_then: Database and search tool that gives startup salespeople contact details for prospects to email.
became: Became a sales intelligence platform; valued at $1.6B in 2023.

name: Gecko Robotics
pitch_then: Wall-climbing robots that crawl boilers and pipes, measuring metal thickness with ultrasound to find weak spots.
became: Raised $125M at a $1.25B valuation in 2025.

name: Caper
pitch_then: Phone app that lets shoppers skip checkout lines in stores and stadiums.
became: Became AI smart shopping carts; Instacart bought it for about $350M in 2021.

name: NURX
pitch_then: Birth control prescribed online by a doctor and mailed to your door.
became: Merged into Thirty Madison in 2022 in an undisclosed all-stock deal.

name: Sendbird
pitch_then: Chat API that lets mobile app developers add messaging between users in a few lines of code.
became: Became a chat and AI agent platform; valued at $1.05B in 2021.

name: Boom
pitch_then: Builds a supersonic passenger jet to fly across oceans in half the time at affordable fares.
became: Raised $300M at about $1.5B in December 2025; flew XB-1 demonstrator.

name: GitPrime
pitch_then: Analytics that turn code repository history into productivity metrics for engineering managers.
became: Acquired by Pluralsight for $170M in 2019.
